newsitem.title: USA: JSB Financial to start trading on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: JSB Financial to start trading on NYSE.

text.p: JSB Financial Inc said Monday its stock will start trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the new symbol "JSB" August 7.
JSB's stock now trades under the symbol "JSBF" on the Nasdaq.

The holding company for the Jamaica Savings Bank FSB, which had $1.53 billion in assets on March 31, said in a statement the listing will provide greater liquidity for its stock and reduce trading volatility.
A spokesman added the company also changed listings to try to close the wide bid-offer spreads on its stock.
JSB stock traded at 44-1/4 Monday afternoon, up 1/8, with the bid at 43-1/2 and the offer at 45-3/8.
An average of 14,700 shares changed hands each day in the first six months of this year, the spokesman said.
